findings.title: Application allows cleartext HTTP traffic
findings.description: The AndroidManifest.xml has android:usesCleartextTraffic=true, allowing unencrypted HTTP connections.
findings.remediation: Set android:usesCleartextTraffic to false in AndroidManifest.xml and use HTTPS for all network calls.

findings.title: Application is debuggable
findings.description: The android:debuggable flag is set to true in the manifest, which should never be enabled in production.
findings.remediation: Remove android:debuggable=true from AndroidManifest.xml for release builds.

findings.title: Hardcoded API key found in source code
findings.description: A string resembling an API key was found hardcoded: AIzaSy***redacted***.
findings.remediation: Move API keys to environment variables or a secure key management system.

findings.title: Use of weak cryptographic algorithm (MD5)
findings.description: MD5 hashing is used for data integrity checks. MD5 is considered cryptographically broken.
findings.remediation: Replace MD5 with SHA-256 or stronger.

findings.title: Exported activity without permission
findings.description: MainActivity is exported without requiring any permission, potentially allowing unauthorized access.
findings.remediation: Add android:permission attribute or set android:exported=false if not needed externally.

findings.title: Sensitive data stored in SharedPreferences without encryption
findings.description: User credentials appear to be stored in SharedPreferences without encryption.
findings.remediation: Use EncryptedSharedPreferences from the AndroidX Security library.
